title: Ammenon
summary: Antediluvian Chaldean king in Berossus. Abydenus gives his length; Apollodorus names him and gives none.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

reign.note: pending CFAH reference (no CFAH anchor point or Table 1 entry found for this)

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 51; Berossus, ap. Apollodorus, ap. Syncellus and Eusebius; the parenthesis compares Polyhistor
reign.note: Apollodorus places the Musarus Oannes in Ammenon's time, and then reports three timings: Polyhistor, the first year; Apollodorus, after forty sari; Abydenus, the second Annedotus after twenty-six sari.

reign.date: “Apollodorus says that it was after forty sari”
reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 51; Berossus, ap. Apollodorus, ap. Syncellus and Eusebius
reign.note: One of the three timings of Oannes in the same parenthesis.

reign.date: “Abydenus, however, makes the second Annedotus appear after twenty-six sari”
reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 51; Berossus, ap. Apollodorus, ap. Syncellus and Eusebius
reign.note: Reported inside Apollodorus's extract. Abydenus's own extract (p. 53) puts a second Annedotus in Amillarus's time and does not repeat "twenty-six sari" there.

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 53; Berossus, ap. Abydenus, ap. Syncellus and Eusebius
reign.note: Ammenon of Pantibiblon. Apollodorus names him and gives him no length.
